value: Leeson, D., Mac Dowell, N., Shah, N., Petit, C., & Fennell, P. S. (2017). A techno-economic analysis and systematic review of carbon capture and storage (CCS) applied to the iron and steel, cement, oil refining and pulp and paper industries, as well as other high purity sources. International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control, 61, 71-84. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijggc.2017.03.020
All costs 2013_USD per tonne CO2 AVOIDED: originals converted to USD at the IMF annual rate for their year, then escalated with CEPCI to 2013 (section 2.2).

The paper reports only costs of CO2 avoided - no capex, opex or energy penalties. Main file: the five base costs its model adopts. Tables 1-5 (the reviewed originals, 61 rows) are in _literature-review, not loaded. Table 6 (exhaust-gas flowrates and CO2 concentrations by source) did not survive text extraction as a table and was not transcribed. The author order in the held copy is Leeson, Mac Dowell, Shah, Petit, Fennell; IPCC's reference list gives Leeson, Fennell, Shah, Petit, Mac Dowell.
